reference: Previous site pixel illustration, used as a style reference only.
intent: A quiet GBA-style corner showing only a bookshelf with books, a window, and a coffee cup on the windowsill; matching day/night composition, with no person.

day.prompt:
Use case: precise-object-edit.
Asset type: day artwork for the existing GBA-style academic portfolio.
Input image 1: edit target and pixel-style reference. Preserve its pixel-art rendering, warm wood, paper/slate colors, gentle daylight, and landscape 3:2 aspect ratio.
Primary request: simplify the illustration to ONLY a wooden bookshelf containing ordinary books, a simple window, and one plain coffee cup sitting on the windowsill near the window. Keep the bookshelf similar to the existing one. The window admits calm daylight against a pale slate/paper wall; outside is just a soft clear sky, with no detailed scenery. Leave breathing room and compose these few elements naturally as a quiet corner.
Remove the human entirely, the chair, the desk, laptop, open books, notebooks, pencil, loose papers, and every other object. The ONLY props are books within the bookshelf and a single coffee cup on the windowsill. No person or face anywhere, no photographs, plants, vases, posters, lamps, extra furniture, text, labels or game UI.
Style constraints: maintain this same original GBA-era pixel illustration style, hard visible pixels and flat color clusters, peaceful simple composition. Warm daylight, restrained lavender/slate, cream paper, ordinary wood. No smooth painting, blur, cinematic effects, gradients or neon.

night.prompt:
Use case: lighting-weather.
Input image 1: edit target, the approved new daytime pixel-art corner. Make its matching NIGHT version for the same portfolio.
Change ONLY time of day, lighting, and colors. Preserve exactly this composition, bookshelf and every book, window/frame/windowsill dimensions, the single coffee cup and handle, object positions, landscape 3:2 aspect ratio, and pixel style.
The window shows a plain peaceful deep indigo night sky; no new scenery or objects. Remove daylight streaks and bright sun patches on the wall and sill. Keep the room softly readable in muted indigo/slate shades with quiet warm wood and a cream-colored coffee cup. Integrate the website's night palette #181d30, #262c43, and warm paper #f0eadb. Light is gentle ambient light from off-screen, not a new lamp. No theatrical glow.
The ONLY content stays the bookshelf with books, window, coffee cup, and plain wall. No human, face, chair, desk, computer, loose books, notebooks, plants, lamps, posters, text, labels or game UI. Retain crisp GBA-era pixel clusters and the same visual style; no blur, smooth digital painting, dramatic lighting or extra detail.

encoding: Optimized WebP export at quality 92; original 1536x1024 dimensions and composition preserved.
